npcs.name: 等车的人
npcs.role: a man waiting for the bus
knows: Bus 332 goes to the Summer Palace

explains.颐和园: 很大的公园，有湖，以前皇帝夏天住在那儿。

npcs.name: 导游
npcs.role: a tour guide with a little flag
npcs.character: Bright and practised; says everything twice.
knows: The Long Corridor has over 14,000 paintings

explains.长廊: 很长很长的路，上面有很多画。

npcs.name: 画画的老人
npcs.role: an old painter copying the corridor's pictures
npcs.character: Soft-spoken; knows every story on the beams.
knows: There is a clay 年兽 for sale at 潘家园 that looks alive

explains.年兽: 一个老的怪兽，过年的时候来，怕红色。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: So this is the Summer Palace!
nodes.why: 颐和园 — the imperial summer garden, a lake and a hill. The Long Corridor 长廊 runs along the water for 700 metres, every beam painted with a story.

nodes.translate: Hello! There are lots of paintings in the Long Corridor.
Hello! For the Summer Palace, take the 332.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: He is waiting for a rabbit.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: 守株待兔 — waiting by the stump for a rabbit! I don't like that one!
nodes.why: A 成语 📌 with a story: a farmer saw a rabbit break its neck on a tree stump, and gave up work to wait for another. 兔儿爷 is offended on behalf of rabbits.

words.explain: 长耳朵的小动物，白色的。

nodes.translate: Hello! Do you like these paintings?

nodes.say: 潘家园有人卖一个年兽。你们去看看吧。
nodes.translate: Someone at 潘家园 is selling a 年兽. Go and have a look.
nodes.why: 年兽 — the Nian beast of New Year stories. 潘家园 is the big antiques market in the south-east: line 10.

nodes.say: 你好！你看，这些画很好看。
nodes.translate: Hello! Look — aren't these paintings lovely.

nodes.say: 我的一个游客不见了！你看见了吗？
nodes.translate: One of my tourists has vanished! Have you seen her?
nodes.why: A small key line: 不见了 — gone missing.

nodes.say: 啊？我的朋友在找我吗？谢谢！
nodes.translate: Oh? My group is looking for me? Thanks!

nodes.say: 你找到她了？太好了！谢谢你！
nodes.translate: You found her? Wonderful! Thank you!

steps.now: 兔儿爷 has a feeling about paintings that come alive. Go to the Summer Palace 颐和园: line 2 to 西直门, then bus 332 from the stop outside.
steps.past: Took line 2 and the 332 bus to the Summer Palace.

steps.now: Walk into the Long Corridor 长廊 and look at the paintings on the beams.
steps.past: Walked the Long Corridor — one of its paintings moved.

steps.now: Ask the old painter in the corridor what he has seen.
steps.past: The old painter in the corridor told me about the 年兽.

steps.now: Go to 潘家园 antiques market — line 10 to 潘家园.
steps.past: Went to the antiques market at 潘家园.

steps.now: The little clay 年兽 is on a stall. Bargain — say 便宜点儿; nobody pays the first price at 潘家园.
steps.past: Bargained for the little clay 年兽 — and it came home with me.

quests.title: The lost tourist
quests.blurb: A tour guide at the Summer Palace has lost one of her group.
quests.lead: A guide at the 颐和园 gate is counting her group again.

steps.now: The guide at the east gate has lost one of her group — a young woman. Look along the Long Corridor.
steps.past: Found the lost tourist in the Long Corridor.
Told the guide her tourist was found.

idioms.meaning: to wait for luck instead of working; to expect the same windfall twice

story.zh: 一个农民在地里工作。一只兔子跑来，撞到树上，死了。农民很高兴，他不工作了，每天在树旁边等兔子。兔子再也没来。
story.en: A farmer was working his field when a rabbit ran into a tree stump and died. Delighted, he stopped working and waited by the stump every day for another. No rabbit ever came again. (兔儿爷 takes this personally.)
